episode.episode_description: Google's Threat Intelligence Group has identified the first autonomous AI framework weaponising security patches in the wild. We explore what this means for the future of digital defence.

selected_story.headline: Autonomous AI framework turns security patches into exploits
selected_story.source_title: Google's TIG reports the first observed instance of attackers using an autonomous AI framework with no human in the loop to turn security patches into exploits (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)

short.title: Autonomous AI framework turns security patches into exploits
short.description:
This marks a shift from AI-assisted hacking to fully autonomous offensive operations, potentially shrinking the window between a vendor releasing a patch and an attacker weaponising it.

short.script: Autonomous AI framework turns security patches into exploits. Google's Threat Intelligence Group has documented the first in-the-wild use of an autonomous AI framework that analyzes software security patches to synthesize and execute exploits without human intervention.
